title: デビュー戦の後に・思惑の外

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: That racer's name, I think it was Agnes Tachyon, right? She was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, she's already so talented, and she still has room for growth!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon's dazzling performance enraptures all those present at the race!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Phew! And that's how you do it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Why, if it isn't Trainer! As always, you have that pure and innocent look befitting of a model guinea pig!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Did you get the tea leaves I wanted?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh right, now isn't the time for this. I must speak to you about something else.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: With the debut race out of the way, instead of catching a breather, I must inform you of something important. You know what I'm getting at, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Something important? And right after the debut race? If I might hazard a guess…
choice_data_list: (Could it be about the next race?)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: My experimentation has reached a standstill, you see. I must return to the lab at once.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: With that said, I will take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that said, she does indeed, take her leave.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She promptly leaves without even a comment about the debut race or a remark about her future prospects.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, it remains true that she has garnered much attention as a noteworthy runner!
